params.name: search
params.description: Search for role bindings by user name, group name, role name, user ID or group ID.

params.name: bound_member_kind
params.description: Filter the list of role bindings by the kind of the bound member. Optional.

params.name: user_types
params.description: Limits the results to a specific set of user types. Only applies to user role bindings.

params.name: page
params.description: The page to return starting from 1 up to total_pages.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records per page. The max is 1000.

items.docs: Lists all role bindings for the group. Requires group_list_role_bindings permission.

Deletes role binding by id. Permission required depends on the role binding type. Deleting an organization role binding requires organization_role_binding_delete permission. Deleting a workspace role binding requires workspace_role_binding_delete permission. Deleting a project role binding requires project_role_binding_delete permission.
